question.q: They exchanged wedding ________ made of gold.
question.justification: في حفلات الزفاف، يتبادل الزوجان الخواتم (ring). الساعة (watch) تُلبس في أي وقت، والقبعة (hat) والحزام (belt) ليسا من طقوس الزواج.
question.context_sentence: They exchanged wedding ________ made of gold.

question.q: I glanced at my ________ to see if I was late.
question.justification: الوقت يُعرف من ساعة اليد (watch). الخاتم (ring) للزينة، والحزام (belt) للملابس، والقبعة (hat) للرأس، وكلها لا تُظهر الوقت.
question.context_sentence: I glanced at my ________ to see if I was late.

question.q: She put on a wide‑brimmed ________ to protect her face from the sun.
question.justification: القبعة (hat) تحمي الرأس من الشمس. الوشاح (scarf) للرقبة، والقفازات (gloves) لليدين، والحزام (belt) للخصر.
question.context_sentence: She put on a wide‑brimmed ________ to protect her face from the sun.

question.q: His trousers kept slipping, so he fastened his ________ tighter.
question.justification: عندما يكون البنطال واسعاً، نشد الحزام (belt). ربطة العنق (tie) على الرقبة، والساعة (watch) في المعصم، والخاتم (ring) في الإصبع.
question.context_sentence: His trousers kept slipping, so he fastened his ________ tighter.

question.q: The children put on their yellow ________ before splashing in the puddles.
question.justification: في المطر نرتدي معطف المطر (raincoat). السترة الصوفية (sweater) للتدفئة، والحذاء (shoes) للقدمين، والنظارات (glasses) للعينين.
question.context_sentence: The children put on their yellow ________ before splashing in the puddles.

question.q: It's chilly outside, so I'll grab a thick ________.
question.justification: للتدفئة في البرد نرتدي سترة صوفية (sweater). المظلة (umbrella) للمطر، والحذاء الرياضي (trainers) للرياضة، والثوب (thobe) لباس تقليدي.
question.context_sentence: It's chilly outside, so I'll grab a thick ________.

question.q: For gym class, you must wear comfortable ________.
question.justification: لكرة القدم نحتاج حذاء رياضياً (trainers). الأحذية العادية (shoes) ليست مناسبة للملاعب، والقفازات (gloves) لليدين، والحزام (belt) ليس للرياضة.
question.context_sentence: For gym class, you must wear comfortable ________.

question.q: She wore woolen ________ to keep her fingers warm in the snow.
question.justification: القفازات (gloves) تحافظ على دفء اليدين. الخواتم (rings) للزينة، والأحزمة (belts) للخصر، والقبعات (hats) للرأس.
question.context_sentence: She wore woolen ________ to keep her fingers warm in the snow.

question.q: He opened his ________ as the rain started to pour.
question.justification: المظلة (umbrella) تقي من المطر. النظارات الواقية (goggles) للعيون، والحقيبة (bag) للحمل، والوشاح (scarf) للرقبة.
question.context_sentence: He opened his ________ as the rain started to pour.

question.q: She wrapped a colorful ________ around her neck before heading out.
question.justification: الوشاح (scarf) يُلف حول الرقبة للتدفئة. ربطة العنق (tie) للأناقة، والحزام (belt) للخصر، والقفاز (glove) لليد.
question.context_sentence: She wrapped a colorful ________ around her neck before heading out.

question.q: The man wore a crisp white ________ for the national celebration.
question.justification: الثوب (thobe) هو الزي التقليدي للرجال في السعودية. ربطة العنق (tie) والبدلة (suit) والقميص (shirt) لباس غربي أو رسمي ولكن ليس الزي اليومي التقليدي.
question.context_sentence: The man wore a crisp white ________ for the national celebration.

question.q: He wore a silk ________ that matched his pocket square perfectly.
question.justification: مع البدلة تُلبس ربطة العنق (tie). الحزام (belt) موجود أيضاً ولكن السؤال يركز على ما يُلبس مع البدلة تحديداً حول الرقبة.
question.context_sentence: He wore a silk ________ that matched his pocket square perfectly.

question.q: For his job interview, he bought a dark blue ________.
question.justification: للمقابلة الرسمية يشتري بدلة (suit). الوشاح (scarf) ليس رسمياً، والثوب (thobe) تقليدي، والسترة (jacket) أقل رسمية من البدلة الكاملة.
question.context_sentence: For his job interview, he bought a dark blue ________.

question.q: The swimmer adjusted her ________ before diving into the pool.
question.justification: السباحون يضعون نظارات واقية (goggles) لحماية العينين من الماء. المظلات (umbrellas) والقبعات (hats) والقفازات (gloves) لا تستخدم في الماء.
question.context_sentence: The swimmer adjusted her ________ before diving into the pool.

question.q: My grandmother still uses an ________ sewing machine, but it works perfectly.
question.justification: إذا كان الشيء يبدو قديماً مقارنة بالموديلات الحديثة، فهو (old fashioned). 'modern' يعني حديث، و'trendy' يعني على الموضة، و'popular' يعني مشهور.
question.context_sentence: My grandmother still uses an ________ sewing machine, but it works perfectly.

question.q: The city skyline is full of ________ glass towers.
question.justification: دبي معروفة بالمباني الحديثة (modern). 'old' قديم، و'ancient' أثري، و'broken' مكسور، وكلها لا تصف أفق دبي.
question.context_sentence: The city skyline is full of ________ glass towers.

question.q: After running for an hour, he felt extremely ________ and drank a whole bottle.
question.justification: عندما تحتاج إلى ماء، فأنت عطشان (thirsty). 'hungry' جائع، 'tired' متعب، 'sleepy' نعسان.
question.context_sentence: After running for an hour, he felt extremely ________ and drank a whole bottle.

question.q: The hikers were ________ after the long walk, so they ate sandwiches.
question.justification: بعد مجهود كبير، يشعر المرء بالجوع (hungry). 'thirsty' عطش، 'happy' سعادة، 'angry' غضب.
question.context_sentence: The hikers were ________ after the long walk, so they ate sandwiches.

question.q: The homemade soup tasted ________, with just the right amount of spices.
question.justification: عندما يكون الطعم طيباً نقول (delicious). 'awful' فظيع، 'salty' مالح، 'bitter' مر، وكلها صفات سلبية غير مناسبة للطعام الجيد.
question.context_sentence: The homemade soup tasted ________, with just the right amount of spices.

question.q: The weather today is ________; it's stormy and freezing cold.
question.justification: الجو البارد والممطر سيئ أو فظيع (awful). 'delicious' لذيذ (للطعام)، 'pleasant' لطيف، 'wonderful' رائع، وكلها إيجابية.
question.context_sentence: The weather today is ________; it's stormy and freezing cold.

question.q: He pressed the ________ harder to cycle up the steep hill.
question.justification: الدراجات الأولى لم يكن بها دواسات (pedals). كانت لها عجلات (wheels)، والسلاسل (chains) والفرامل (brakes) أتت لاحقاً.
question.context_sentence: He pressed the ________ harder to cycle up the steep hill.

question.q: Macmillan fixed foot ________ to his bicycle to move it forward.
question.justification: ماكميلان أضاف روافع (levers) تُحرك بالقدم. 'pedals' دواسات (اختراع لاحق)، 'wheels' عجلات، 'chains' سلاسل.
question.context_sentence: Macmillan fixed foot ________ to his bicycle to move it forward.

question.q: The telephone is a revolutionary ________ that changed communication.
question.justification: الدراجة ليست اختراعاً (invention) جديداً. 'destruction' تدمير، 'game' لعبة، 'problem' مشكلة.
question.context_sentence: The telephone is a revolutionary ________ that changed communication.

question.q: Water seeped through a ________ in the sea floor.
question.justification: الماء يدخل من خلال الشقوق أو الصدوع (cracks) في قاع البحر. 'mountains' جبال، 'valleys' وديان، 'tunnels' أنفاق.
question.context_sentence: Water seeped through a ________ in the sea floor.

question.q: Salt is a natural ________ found in many foods.
question.justification: الملح معدن (mineral) شائع. 'plant' نبات، 'animal' حيوان، 'liquid' سائل.
question.context_sentence: Salt is a natural ________ found in many foods.

question.q: The puddle ________ in the hot sun within an hour.
question.justification: البحر تبخر (evaporated) تماماً. 'froze' تجمد، 'expanded' توسع، 'flooded' فاض.
question.context_sentence: The puddle ________ in the hot sun within an hour.

question.q: Wires inside the cable are made of ________ because it conducts electricity well.
question.justification: النحاس (Copper) معدن أحمر اللون. الحديد (Iron) رمادي، والفضة (Silver) بيضاء، والزنك (Zinc) أبيض مائل للزرقة.
question.context_sentence: Wires inside the cable are made of ________ because it conducts electricity well.

question.q: People with ________ must monitor their blood sugar regularly.
question.justification: السكري (Diabetes) هو المرض الذي يؤثر على استخدام الجسم للسكر. 'Asthma' ربو، 'Cancer' سرطان، 'Headache' صداع.
question.context_sentence: People with ________ must monitor their blood sugar regularly.

question.q: Type I diabetics need daily ________ injections to survive.
question.justification: مرضى السكري من النوع الأول يحتاجون حقن الأنسولين (insulin). 'vitamin' فيتامين، 'calcium' كالسيوم، 'antibiotic' مضاد حيوي.
question.context_sentence: Type I diabetics need daily ________ injections to survive.

question.q: During digestion, carbohydrates are broken down into ________ for energy.
question.justification: الجلوكوز (Glucose) هو سكر بسيط يعطي طاقة. 'Protein' بروتين، 'Fat' دهن، 'Fiber' ألياف.
question.context_sentence: During digestion, carbohydrates are broken down into ________ for energy.

question.q: Pasta and bread are rich in ________, which give you energy.
question.justification: الخبز والأرز مصادر للكربوهيدرات (carbohydrates). 'fats' دهون، 'proteins' بروتينات، 'vitamins' فيتامينات.
question.context_sentence: Pasta and bread are rich in ________, which give you energy.

question.q: The doctor gave her medicine to ________ the severe back pain.
question.justification: الدواء يخفف (alleviate) الألم. 'worsen' يزيده سوءاً، 'ignore' يتجاهل، 'increase' يزيد.
question.context_sentence: The doctor gave her medicine to ________ the severe back pain.

question.q: A runny nose and sneezing are common ________ of a cold.
question.justification: الحمى عرض (symptom) من أعراض الإنفلونزا. 'cause' سبب، 'cure' علاج، 'disease' مرض.
question.context_sentence: A runny nose and sneezing are common ________ of a cold.

question.q: The doctor examined a sample of ________ under the microscope.
question.justification: الأنسجة (tissues) هي التي تتضرر بالأمراض. 'bones' عظام، 'muscles' عضلات، 'teeth' أسنان.
question.context_sentence: The doctor examined a sample of ________ under the microscope.

question.q: Drinking water aids the process of ________ after a heavy meal.
question.justification: الطعام يُهضم أثناء عملية الهضم (digestion). 'sleep' نوم، 'exercise' تمارين، 'reading' قراءة.
question.context_sentence: Drinking water aids the process of ________ after a heavy meal.

question.q: A healthy ________ includes plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
question.justification: النظام الغذائي (diet) المتوازن أساسي للصحة. 'exercise' تمارين، 'hobby' هواية، 'habit' عادة.
question.context_sentence: A healthy ________ includes plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.

question.q: Only the top of the iceberg is ________ above the water; the rest lies hidden.
question.justification: المادة المرئية (visible) هي التي تُرى. 'dark' مظلم، 'hidden' مخفي، 'invisible' غير مرئي.
question.context_sentence: Only the top of the iceberg is ________ above the water; the rest lies hidden.

question.q: The moon's ________ pull causes the ocean tides.
question.justification: للمادة المظلمة تأثيرات جاذبية (gravitational). 'electrical' كهربائية، 'chemical' كيميائية، 'thermal' حرارية.
question.context_sentence: The moon's ________ pull causes the ocean tides.

question.q: Tea is the most popular hot ________ in the world, especially in Britain.
question.justification: القهوة مشروب (beverage) شعبي. 'food' طعام، 'sport' رياضة، 'machine' آلة.
question.context_sentence: Tea is the most popular hot ________ in the world, especially in Britain.

question.q: A mirage is an ________ illusion caused by the bending of light rays.
question.justification: قوس قزح ظاهرة بصرية (optical). 'musical' موسيقية، 'medical' طبية، 'mechanical' ميكانيكية.
question.context_sentence: A mirage is an ________ illusion caused by the bending of light rays.
